about: Settings files of frameworks that work while the game runs, by the name such a file must have, and how a line of one is laid out (TL01§23). ModTrap's data, not code. With it ModTrap says where in a line a plugin is named: as the thing the line gives or changes, as a condition for what the line reaches, or as an exclusion. 'layout' is 'pipes' for a line of the form key = first|more|more, where a condition can start with - (leave out), and conditions joined by + must all hold. What each framework does with a line that names a plugin which is not loaded is in the research note, with its source. Only frameworks whose handling of a missing plugin was read in their source are listed; a file of any other kind is left to the owner. 'flm' is the layout of FormList Manipulator: key = list|forms|filter, or Filter = name|conditions, where a condition is a plugin's name with + (only while that plugin is active) or - (only while it is not). 'dll' is the framework's program file in SKSE/Plugins, where it was read in the framework's own build files; the scanner uses it to say which frameworks of the modlist ModTrap reads the files of. 'places' are the folders of a mod, beside its top folder, that the scanner looks through for settings files, to their end.

places.why: where a program that works inside the game (an SKSE plugin) is installed, and by custom keeps its settings
FormList Manipulator reads any INI file in it
